summary: The Tahara and Shima dual-citation defect is resolved: reference [5] now carries only the 1995 paper (PMID 7497851, DOI verified), and the prose attribution reads '(1995)' only. All seven sources are Tier 1/2, tags are correctly applied (mechanism_review for biochemistry/kinetics, cohort for ADAG, regulatory for NGSP/IFCC master equation), population annotation for the ADAG cohort is complete (n=507 with subgroup breakdown), and the mechanistic reasoning chain is internally consistent with no unsupported claims.
